title: Planet One
description: A whitelisted modded Minecraft server with a long-term world, friendly community and laid-back feel.
body:
Planet One is a long term, whitelisted modded Minecraft SMP server, hosted in Europe. We have a tight-knit, dedicated community with players from Europe and the USA who collaborate on building and infrastructure projects (like railways!).

# 1.20.1 Build Showcase

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/bI9xwX3kSpE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# The Pack
We run the [CPWN Pack 2](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cpwn-2), a custom modpack built specifically for this server. Some of the well-known mods in it are:

- Create & Create Aeronautics
- Farmer's Delight
- Alex's Caves
- Aquaculture 2
- Chipped
- Ars Nouveau

...but we have many more!

Currently we are running an End Survival event, exploring a structure-filled end on a Create Aeronautics airship. The overworld with our existing builds is closed until we successfully fight the Ender Dragon and are able to return there. Come and join the crew!


# The World
The current world has been running since **October 2024** and was originally created in 1.16.5. It was updated to 1.20.1 in late 2025 and has since been updated it to 1.21.1, with new terrain regenerated around player builds.

The goal is for this to be the **final modded world I'll ever play on** - I don't ever aim to reset this, instead updating once the majority of mods in the pack have transitioned over to a new version.

Outside of the map's original 1.16.5 spawn region - dubbed the **"Origin Isle"** - the world has been generated with Terralith &  Biomes O Plenty. Alex's Caves are spread throughout it and we have plenty of variety both above and below ground for keen explorers.

The world is on Hard Mode, so you'll need to think about how you gear up and build your base.

We have Waystones, but they can't be crafted or moved. If you want to do long distance travel, you'll need to build your own roads and railways - something many players have already done!


# The Rules
- No PVP, griefing or bullying of any kind is permitted.
- You can build anywhere, but if you're building in the Origin Isle (the original 1.16.5 chunks) please check with an admin first.
- The golden rule is to **be kind to one another.**


# Who are we looking for?
We are looking for 18+ players from anywhere in the world who are happy with a **slow pace**, focusing on their own builds or collaborating with others over the long term in a shared SMP experience. You will also need to be able to communicate in English.

We are all busy with work, kids and other responsibilities and only really get to play some evenings and weekends. It's about quality, not quantity. **If you're a no-lifer or a speedrunner, this server isn't for you.**

To be whitelisted, [please fill in the Planet One Application Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdTgesZwNmIniQeAyDg3G0KsH_IA83kphzURjqyCHyXUvvBkw/viewform?usp=publish-editor) and I'll message you on Discord or via email to chat further and bring you on board.

We would love for you to join us! Hopefully see you soon!

All the best,

Kwikxilver - Server Owner
